title: UIAO LocPath Location Registry
description: Envelope for an executable LocPath location registry (ADR-102 §D6 / UIAO_194). A registry is a versioned, provenance-anchored collection of location nodes; each node is validated individually against location.schema.json at load time by uiao.modernization.locpath (no JSON Schema $ref, so per-node errors stay addressable). The 'reference' registry shipped as executable canon is the UIAO_194 worked example, not deployment data — agency registries are loaded from their own paths with the same contract.

schema_version.description: Location-registry schema version (independent of the node schema). Major pinned to 1.

document_id.description: Location registries are executable canon under the UIAO_194 allocation, the way codebook.yaml is under UIAO_151 and binding profiles are under UIAO_193.

registry_id.description: Kebab-case stable identifier. 'reference' is the canonical worked example shipped with the substrate; agency registries use their own ids.

status.description: reference = the canonical worked example (UIAO_194 §Worked example); proposed = specified, not yet authoritative; active = the governed location registry of record; deprecated = retiring, must name successor.

updated.description: Date of last governed change to this registry.

nodes.description: Location nodes. Each is validated against location.schema.json plus the UIAO_194 integrity rules (level/depth consistency, uniqueness, parent existence) at load time.
